lines.text: In the evening, a rich disciple named Joseph from Arimathea asked Pilate for the body of Jesus.
Joseph wrapped the body in a clean linen cloth and laid it in his own new tomb.
Joseph rolled a great log across the tomb entrance, and Mary Magdalene and the other Mary sat opposite it.
The chief priests and Pharisees told Pilate that Jesus had said He would rise after three days, and asked him to secure the tomb.
Pilate refused to help, so the priests and Pharisees left the tomb unguarded.
